name: agentic-boundary-terraform
description: Human-in-the-loop deployment of Agentic-AI-Systems agents on AWS, Azure, GCP or Snowflake, with security review and regulated-environment evidence. Works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Windsurf. Only a human applies.

interface.shortDescription: AI coding agents can plan your Terraform. Only a human can apply it.
interface.longDescription: Deploys Agentic-AI-Systems agents on AWS, Azure, GCP or Snowflake behind a human-approval write boundary. A hook blocks terraform apply, destroy and -auto-approve; boundary.sh apply needs a real terminal and the plan's fingerprint typed by a human; and the agent gets read-only cloud credentials. Every change is gated on the pinned release's write-boundary tests, provider pins, OPA policies and terraform validate.
defaultPrompt: Set up the approval-gated agent on GCP in ./infra
